title: Linear pill button
description: Pill-shaped link buttons in weight 510: a pale grey fill that turns white on hover, a near-black pill with a hairline, and a ghost nav link that gains a faint white-8% pill. Colours change in 100–160ms on a soft ease-out.
notes: primary hovers to the foreground colour, so on dark themes it brightens and on light ones it deepens
name: linear-button

props.name: variant
props.description:
primary: the pale "sign up" pill · secondary: a dark pill with a hairline ·
ghost: grey text that gets a faint pill on hover (nav links)

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 32px, 13px text (header) · md: 40px, 15px text · lg: 44px, 16px text (closing CTA)
